integrity.uncertainty: An unindexed broader mathematical result could imply the clock bound. No independent validation has been performed.

scientific_limitations: Single-mode, zero-temperature single-photon loss; exact instantaneous full-state preparation of the two-photon Fock state; IID positive finite-mean clock; equilibrium-age sampling. The threshold is for existence of stationary Wigner negativity over clocks at a fixed mean, not for integrated negativity or imperfect physical devices. Publication priority remains unverified independently.
title: A sharp mean-clock threshold for renewal-preserved two-photon Wigner negativity
